episode_title: Episode 54: How Brittney Murphy Became a Top 10 Agent In Just Two Years

real_qa.q: How did Brittney Murphy achieve top 10 agent status at Matt Curtis Real Estate in just two years as a new agent?
real_qa.r: Murphy attributes her success primarily to the team at Matt Curtis Real Estate, including leadership with vision and goals, the team systems in place, training, tools, resources, and particularly the closing team. She emphasizes that having a diverse portfolio of lead sources rather than relying on a single source like Zillow was critical, allowing her to pivot when algorithms shifted.
real_qa.requete: Brittney Murphy Matt Curtis Real Estate top 10 agent two years

real_qa.q: What is Brittney Murphy's biggest goal for real estate in 2024?
real_qa.r: Murphy's biggest goal right now for real estate is trying to sell 30 homes this year. Matt Curtis notes this is something very few agents will accomplish, especially in their second year in the business.

real_qa.q: What was Brittney Murphy's career background before joining Matt Curtis Real Estate?
real_qa.r: Murphy was traditionally a molecular biologist and then moved into sales, where she worked for approximately 15 years in that industry. She traveled over 200 days per year during this period before moving back to Huntsville to help with aging grandparents and family members, which prompted her transition into real estate.
real_qa.requete: Brittney Murphy molecular biologist sales background

real_qa.q: What lead sources does Matt Curtis Real Estate use beyond Zillow to support agents?
real_qa.r: Matt Curtis Real Estate has a diverse portfolio including Market VIP, Realtor.com, billboards, and web leads. The team receives approximately 50 Google Local Service Ads leads per month. Murphy particularly likes call-in leads from billboards and people who recognize the Matt Curtis marketing and name.
real_qa.requete: Matt Curtis Real Estate lead sources billboards Market VIP

real_qa.q: What key principle has Brittney Murphy learned about discipline and success in real estate?
real_qa.r: Murphy emphasizes that discipline equals freedom in real estate. Staying consistent and disciplined in daily activities is what gets an agent's plane off the ground and maintains momentum. Without discipline, agents become reactive to whatever is thrown at them daily, which creates chaos rather than the balance they seek.
real_qa.requete: discipline equals freedom real estate agent balance
